message: Raw AntD <Table> / HTML <table> at a call site — every AhaSlides grid renders through the DS DataTable. Build with (or extend) the DS DataTable instead.
Forbidden icon set — AhaSlides icons come from the DS icon set (<aha-icon> / the shared Icon). Material / lucide / heroicons / fontawesome / @ant-design/icons are never allowed.

AhaSlides logo file detected. If it is the top-left brand of a site, microsite or app header, use <aha-product-lockup product="<name>"> instead of hand-setting the logo beside a text span (app-shell C1). Ignore for a footer, favicon or logo gallery.
Overlay detected — check it against the DS overlays surface before finalising.

Settings / preferences UI detected — a modal or drawer holding settings is the DS settings surface (plus overlays for the shell). Read the DS settings hub control table to pick each setting's control before finalising.
Feedback surface detected (toast / notification / Alert) — check it against the DS feedback surface before finalising.
If this Tag/Badge shows a domain object's lifecycle state (draft/published/closed/…), use the DS status badge. Ignore if it is a generic non-status tag.
There may be a DS primitive for this (useIsMobile, field error, live region, empty / loading state) — reach for it before rolling your own.

signature: (?i:some items could not be loaded|something went wrong|an error occurred|an unexpected error|\boops\b)
message: Vague error copy — name the object and what happened, and offer a next step so it doesn't dead-end.
Title-Cased slide-type / UI name — product UI is sentence case ('Multiple choice', 'Word cloud'). Ignore if this is prose, not a UI label.
